test_title: PYST 73: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On 24 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e8c734179d70be46677b368c292f4dd16273f32b8431d4b4892db58a0ab5214.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**From figure 1 to 2 and figure 3 to 4:**

Symbols are shifting their position in zig-zag way.

**From figure 2 to 3 and figure 4 to 5:**

Top-right, middle, and bottom-left symbols are interchanging their position.

Top-left and bottom-right letters are interchanging their position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/874cf9fb0b4e49a3dce5226250c73b3f4903a7fd114ffeafcf06e1aaffee526a.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
